customers.evidence: Our mission is to deliver great value to our customers every day.

employees.evidence: With stores and offices around the world, there is a breadth of opportunities at TJX to discover a career in retail.

environment.evidence: We are committed to making a positive, sustainable impact on the world in which we live and conduct business.

shareholders.evidence: Over the course of our history, our strong financial returns and cash generation have allowed us to simultaneously invest in the growth of the business and return cash to shareholders for decades.

result.analyst_notes: Mission-led and factual in tone, with customer value placed first and repeated. Shareholder returns and financial performance are framed as outcomes of the model. Sustainability commitment is brief and generic. Voice is mainly third-person corporate, with a few first-person plural statements and an exclamatory flourish about future size.
